MaXXXine could be the final entry in TI West's X trilogy from A24. Mia Gothe returns in the titular role, as the sole survivor from X. A release date hasn't been revealed, but Gothe and West have been hyping up the project. What should fans of X expect in this final chapter? I'll recap plot details, reveal Halsey's role, and give hints about the new killer. Maxine has made it in Hollywood, but the past comes back to haunt her. The July leak has been confirmed.
